item.title: Your Claude Desktop connectors are reusable MCP servers
item.description:
Claude Desktop connectors are plain MCP servers on disk. Claude Code can run the same server from its own config. You install once, and both clients get the integration. I connected Fantastical, my calendar app, to Claude Code this way in about 10 minutes.

The false start

My first plan was a third-party Fantastical bridge from an MCP directory site. The network I was on killed that plan. A captive portal intercepted TLS for the directory site, and curl got a certificate for secure-login.attwifi.com instead. GitHub worked. The directory site did not.
